name: NUST undergraduate (NET basis)
institution: National University of Sciences & Technology (NUST), Islamabad

components.name: HSSC / FSc (Part-1 or full) / A Level / DAE

note: General criteria for admission on NET basis. Candidates still in A Level are given 25% weight on O Level equivalence marks (IBCC). ACT/SAT applicants for national seats use the same 75/10/15 split with the ACT/SAT score in place of NET.

name: MBBS / BDS open merit (PM&DC, MDCAT)
institution: Pakistan Medical & Dental Council (public and private medical and dental colleges)
note: Set by the PM&DC (Admissions, Curriculum and Conduct) Policy and Regulations 2026, notified 12 October 2026, for open merit seats in public and private colleges. Armed Forces-administered colleges admit through NUMS and its own admission test.
